findings.evidence: MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean:103 `namespace EpsilonEridani`; :171-175 `theorem symmCompOfNondegenerate_minkowskiProduct_apply {d : ℕ} (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ (Lorentz.Vector d)) ...`; Nondegenerate.lean:31 `namespace LinearMap.BilinForm`, :39 `theorem eq_symmCompOfNondegenerate_iff (B₁ : BilinForm K V) ...`; rubric: a declaration whose first explicit argument has an existing Mathlib type belongs in that type's namespace.
findings.fix: Move the declaration into `namespace LinearMap.BilinForm` (keeping the name), so consumers get `F.symmCompOfNondegenerate_minkowskiProduct_apply`; the `open EpsilonEridani (...)` list in Relativity/LightConeBasis.lean:193 then drops it.
findings.issue: `EpsilonEridani.symmCompOfNondegenerate_minkowskiProduct_apply` is a lemma about Mathlib's `LinearMap.BilinForm.symmCompOfNondegenerate` whose first explicit argument is `F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ (Lorentz.Vector d)`, an upstream type, so `F.symmCompOfNondegenerate_minkowskiProduct_apply` does not elaborate and the declaration cannot move upstream without renaming. The PR's own companion lemma for the same Mathlib definition is placed correctly (`LinearMap.BilinForm.eq_symmCompOfNondegenerate_iff`, Nondegenerate.lean:39), and this file already hosts a `Lorentz.Vector` namespace block (lines 52-101) for dot-notation material.

findings.evidence: Relativity/LightConeBasis.lean:93 `namespace LightConeBasis` under :82 `namespace LinearMap.BilinForm`; :199 `transverseEpsRaise_minkowskiProduct_apply`, :211 `minkowskiProduct_transverseEpsRaise`, :183 `finrank_transverse_minkowskiProduct_eq_two` vs :250 `transverseEpsRaise_comp_self_apply`, :264 `transverseEpsRaise_comp_self`, both taking `L : LightConeBasis (minkowskiProduct (d := 3)).toBilinForm` (:219).
findings.fix: Rename to `transverseEpsRaise_minkowskiProduct_comp_self` and `transverseEpsRaise_minkowskiProduct_comp_self_apply` (the marker the PR description says round 1 asked for and which was dropped), and update the module docstring reference at line 45/70.
findings.issue: `transverseEpsRaise_comp_self` and `transverseEpsRaise_comp_self_apply` (line 250) are specific to `(minkowskiProduct (d := 3)).toBilinForm` yet live in the same `LinearMap.BilinForm.LightConeBasis` namespace as the general-`B` theory (Mathematics/.../LightConeBasis.lean:343-488, e.g. `transverseEpsRaise_comp_transverseProj`). Every other Minkowski specialisation in this section carries a marker (`transverseEpsRaise_minkowskiProduct_apply`, `minkowskiProduct_transverseEpsRaise`, `finrank_transverse_minkowskiProduct_eq_two`), so these two names read as general statements and would clash with a future general-form version.

summary: Names mostly follow Mathlib's 2D precedent in TwoDim.lean (areaForm / rightAngleRotation) and are fine. Two problems: a lemma about Mathlib's symmCompOfNondegenerate is filed under EpsilonEridani instead of its type's namespace, and the two Minkowski-4D-specific comp_self lemmas lack the minkowskiProduct marker every neighbour in the same shared namespace carries.
